upstream_claim.evidence: FPW_SOURCE.json states this was the archived upstream source. This audit verifies the pinned FPW tree; it does not establish the current RS repository ancestry.

verification_method: For each shared resource, the RS raw bytes or a strictly LF-to-CRLF text reconstruction reproduce BOTH the FPW Git blob SHA1 returned for the pinned commit and the RESOURCE_PIN SHA256. No JSON, CSV, TOML, numeric or binary reserialization is used.

normalization_rules.utf8_crlf_to_lf: Recognized .json/.csv/.txt/.toml resources only: strict UTF-8, replace CRLF with LF, reject remaining bare CR. Preserve all other bytes including spaces, numeric tokens, key order and final newline.
normalization_rules.none: Raw bytes only. In particular every .npy and .lut is binary and is never newline-normalized.

identity_encoding: SHA256 of ASCII JSON containing sorted [path, canonical_sha256] pairs, using separators comma and colon without whitespace. Engine and calibration sets have separate identities.
